lines.zh: 最在意你出丑的人，其实只有你自己。
lines.en: The one who cares most about your embarrassment is you.

lines.zh: 我们总以为，别人都在盯着自己的失误，
lines.en: We always think others are watching our mistakes,

lines.zh: 可大多数人，连你说过什么都记不住。
lines.en: but most people can't even remember what you said.

lines.zh: 开会说错一个词，你一下午都抬不起头；
lines.en: Say one wrong word in a meeting, and you can't look up all afternoon;

lines.zh: 朋友圈发完又删，就怕点赞太少；
lines.en: you post, then delete, afraid of too few likes;

lines.zh: 被人多看一眼，就开始检查自己哪里不对。
lines.en: one extra glance, and you start checking what's wrong with you.

lines.zh: 心理学里有个概念，叫聚光灯效应，
lines.en: Psychology has a name for this: the spotlight effect.

lines.zh: 简单来说，就是高估别人对自己的关注。
lines.en: Simply put, we overestimate how much others notice us.

lines.zh: 心理学家做过一个实验，
lines.en: Psychologists once ran an experiment:

lines.zh: 让学生穿件尴尬的T恤走进教室。
lines.en: students walked into a classroom wearing an embarrassing T-shirt.

lines.zh: 他们以为，一半的人都注意到了，
lines.en: They guessed half the room noticed,

lines.zh: 结果真正留意的，还不到四分之一。
lines.en: but fewer than a quarter actually did.

lines.zh: 我以前也是这样。
lines.en: I used to be the same.

lines.zh: 有一次上台分享，我把一个名字念错了，
lines.en: Once, giving a talk, I mispronounced a name.

lines.zh: 台下有人笑了一声，我后背一下就湿了。
lines.en: Someone laughed, and my back broke into a sweat.

lines.zh: 那天晚上，我把那一秒回放了几十遍，
lines.en: That night I replayed that second dozens of times,

lines.zh: 心里只有一句话：完了，社死了。
lines.en: with one thought: that's it, I'm socially dead.

lines.zh: 第二天我问同事，他愣了一下：
lines.en: The next day I asked a colleague. He paused:

lines.zh: 啊？你念错了吗？
lines.en: "Huh? You said it wrong?"

lines.zh: 那一刻我才发现，
lines.en: That's when I realized

lines.zh: 那场审判，只有我一个人在场。
lines.en: I was the only one at that trial.

lines.zh: 因为在你的故事里，你是主角，
lines.en: In your story, you're the lead,

lines.zh: 可在别人的故事里，你只是一个路过的人。
lines.en: but in everyone else's, you're just a passer-by.

lines.zh: 越在意越放大，越放大越不敢开口。
lines.en: The more you care, the bigger it gets; the bigger it gets, the less you dare to speak.

lines.zh: 很多紧张，不是来自别人的眼光，
lines.en: Much of our nervousness doesn't come from others' eyes,

lines.zh: 而是来自我们给自己安排的观众。
lines.en: but from the audience we arrange for ourselves.

lines.zh: 真正松弛的人，并不是不在乎别人，
lines.en: Truly relaxed people don't ignore others;

lines.zh: 而是知道，没人会一直盯着你的缺点。
lines.en: they just know no one keeps staring at your flaws.

lines.zh: 你可以说错话，可以出丑，可以不完美，
lines.en: You can misspeak, look silly, be imperfect,

lines.zh: 但不必把每次失误，都当成公开审判。
lines.en: but you don't have to treat every slip as a public trial.

lines.zh: 所谓自信，不是确信自己不会出错，
lines.en: Confidence isn't being sure you won't make mistakes,

lines.zh: 而是终于明白，
lines.en: it's finally understanding

lines.zh: 台下的人，其实都在忙着照亮自己。
lines.en: that the audience is busy lighting up their own lives.
